label: enable-push-build-trigger
command:
from pathlib import Path;p=Path(".github/workflows/build-experimental.yml");s=p.read_text();s=s.replace("  workflow_dispatch:
","  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [.github/workflows/build-experimental.yml]
");p.write_text(s)
action: 为云端构建增加主分支工作流文件变更触发，绕过当前失效的命令行调度凭据。
outcome: 仅工作流文件本身变化触发构建，进度 MD 的更新不会循环触发。
next_step: 通过 GitHub 插件发布已有构建源码与触发配置。
